review:
I just think that a little more communication and understanding could have prevented much of the drama here. Anyway, the film revolves around a revelation concerning Zendaya's character; while it was shocking, I didn't find it as earth-shattering as it seemed to be for some of the characters, especially considering the character's age and circumstances at the time of the event (which I feel weren't explored deeply enough).

The film only really gained momentum for me during the finale, when things began to escalate beyond the initial revelation and the real drama kicked in. The acting and editing are good; I just wish it had gotten to the core drama a bit faster.
